d:
8 March 2014 ki raat Malaysia Airlines ki flight MH370 ne Kuala Lumpur se Beijing ke liye udaan bhari. Lekin kuch hi der baad plane ka communication band ho gaya aur woh radar se gayab ho gaya. Plane mein 239 log sawar the, aur phir shuru hui duniya ki sabse badi aviation mysteries mein se ek ki talaash.
Captain Zaharie Ahmad Shah ke personal life se jude sawaal, unke flight simulator se recover hua route data aur Hind Mahasagar ki taraf mudta plane. Kya yeh sab ek planned disappearance ki taraf ishara karte hain? Ya MH370 ke gayab hone ka sach ab bhi samundar ki gehraiyon mein chhupa hai?
